measured_effective_context.interpretation: For a current captured target frame, the 16-pair causal input can contain at most 15 preceding complete captured frame/action pairs plus the current pair. E and C count usable pre-current history, not the current sample itself.

cadence.frame_stacking_or_packing: One 336-visual-token plus 11-action-token pair per captured frame; no multi-frame packing.

exact_prospective_extraction_path.window_rule: For every target captured frame, make an independent teacher-forced call on the trailing contiguous window ending at that frame, capped at 16 complete frame/action pairs.
exact_prospective_extraction_path.position_ids: Reset to contiguous 0..sequence_length-1 for each independent window.
exact_prospective_extraction_path.attention: Causal self-attention over the unpadded window.
exact_prospective_extraction_path.runtime_kv_behavior: refresh_kvcache() is called before each teacher-forced transformer call.
exact_prospective_extraction_path.sliding_window_behavior: Explicit overlapping trailing windows; never disjoint 16-frame chunks for scientific Regime A.
exact_prospective_extraction_path.activation_target: Layer 4 FULL_TOKEN_GRID values at the current pair's 336 visual-token positions.

warmup_and_prefix.rule: The first 15 target frames lack the full E=15 history and are unusable for primary full-context Regime-A analyses.
warmup_and_prefix.clear_lead_in_requirement: At least 16 clear captured samples spanning 15 intervals must precede the first stable occluded target sample.

source_provenance.facts: 336 visual + 11 action tokens, 347 tokens/pair, 16 pairs, 5552 positions, hidden width 2048, 20 layers.
Trailing pair truncation, pair assembly, position IDs, causal teacher-forced call, and cache refresh.
